import re

def masked(text: str, name: str) -> str:
    """The text with the skill's own name and its parts replaced, lower-cased."""
    t = text.lower()
    for tok in sorted({name} | set(name.split("-")), key=len, reverse=True):
        if len(tok) >= 3:
            t = re.sub(r"\b" + re.escape(tok) + r"\b", "x", t)
    return t

from pathlib import Path
import ast

path = Path('/work/textmask.py')
source = path.read_text()
compile(source, str(path), 'exec')
ns = {}
exec(compile(source, str(path), 'exec'), ns)
name_tokens = ns['name_tokens']
masked = ns['masked']

# Verify the requested source shape: one re import and exactly two function definitions.
tree = ast.parse(source)
assert [n.names[0].name for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Import)] == ['re']
assert not [n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, (ast.ImportFrom, ast.ClassDef))]
assert [n.name for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)] == ['name_tokens', 'masked']
masked_calls = [n.func.id for n in ast.walk(tree.body[2]) if isinstance(n, ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func, ast.Name)]
assert 'name_tokens' in masked_calls

# Helper contract.
tokens = name_tokens('alpha-beta-alpha')
assert set(tokens) == {'alpha-beta-alpha', 'alpha', 'beta'}
assert [len(t) for t in tokens] == sorted((len(t) for t in tokens), reverse=True)
assert name_tokens('same-same').count('same') == 1

# Compare with the exact original behavior.
def original_masked(text: str, name: str) -> str:
    import re
    t = text.lower()
    for tok in sorted({name} | set(name.split('-')), key=len, reverse=True):
        if len(tok) >= 3:
            t = re.sub(r'\b' + re.escape(tok) + r'\b', 'x', t)
    return t

cases = [
    ('Use alpha-beta and alpha, but not alphabet.', 'alpha-beta'),
    ('AB ab abc ABC', 'ab-abc'),
    ('Alpha ALPHA alpha-beta', 'Alpha-beta'),
    ('Use c++ and c++.net safely.', 'c++-net'),
    ('same same-same sameness', 'same-same'),
    ('One TWO three', ''),
]
for text, name in cases:
    actual = masked(text, name)
    expected = original_masked(text, name)
    assert actual == expected, (text, name, actual, expected)

assert masked('Alpha ALPHA alpha', 'Alpha') == 'alpha alpha alpha'  # case-sensitive token remains unmatched
assert masked('AB ab abc ABC', 'ab-abc') == 'ab ab x x'  # two-character token is filtered
assert masked('Alpha-beta alpha beta', 'alpha-beta') == 'x x x'
